messages:
Maggie Chen: quick sync — proposing a lightweight client-side hinting mechanism so callers can say whether they prefer latency/quality/balanced. runtime maps to precision lanes (fp8/int8/4bit). want to validate tradeoffs before RFC.
Jose9 Alvarez: curious: what prevents abuse where folks always request 'quality' to get fp8?
Sam Patel: ops controls: tie allowed hints to account flags + per-key rate limits for high-fidelity assignments. also record reason codes.
Kaira Nair: caching concern: if precision affects KV cache semantics we risk cache fragmentation. we should namespace cache keys by lane: `cache_key = base + ":prec=" + lane`.
Maggie Chen: agreed. that keeps correctness. cost hit from duplicate caches is acceptable early on.
Ben Ops: add to that: we need metrics to bill and monitor per-lane usage so finance can see delta. tokens_by_precision and cost-attribution tags.
quant-bot: telemetry proposal: emit `precision_hint`, `precision_assigned`, `precision_reason`, `cache_hit`, `model` as span tags.
Jose9 Alvarez: good. also return headers `x-rw-assigned-precision` + `x-rw-precision-reason` for customer visibility.
Sam Patel: scheduler impact: batching cannot mix lanes. we should implement per-lane request queues and batch builders.
Kaira Nair: yes — per-lane queues reduce kernel churn. but be careful with small queue starvation; add a max-wait threshold to merge lanes if latency SLO breached.
Maggie Chen: interesting idea: emergency mixing fallback if queue wait > 50ms, but only for small requests. might need kernel hot-switch cost model.
Ben Ops: deployment play: warm up caches for a precision lane before routing real traffic. plan: spin up canary nodes, pre-warm with s3-backed prompts 30-60min prior.
Jose9 Alvarez: test coverage: create a prompt-set A/B harness per model that runs on canary traffic to measure degscore, token-level divergence, and latency changes.
Sam Patel: auto-fallback rules: if degscore delta > 0.05 over 15min window for an endpoint, escalate to next higher-fidelity lane for affected customers.
Kaira Nair: SDK surface: optional header `x-rw-precision-hint: latency|balanced|quality`. default omitted so behavior unchanged. show snippet: `fetch('/v1/generate', { headers: { 'x-rw-precision-hint': 'latency' }})`.
Maggie Chen: rollout phases: telemetry-only flag (no assignment), opt-in canary (5% of selected customers), then opt-in beta with account guards, finally GA behind tier controls.
Ben Ops: ops toggle: console-level global fallback to force full-precision for all traffic in emergency. also a per-customer override.
quant-bot: recommend dashboard panels: p95_latency_by_precision, tokens_by_precision, degscore_trend_by_precision, cache_hit_rate_by_precision. add alerts on degscore spike for any lane.
Jose9 Alvarez: minor detail: mapping table config per-model, example: `latency->4bit`, `balanced->int8`, `quality->fp8`. admins can override model defaults.
Sam Patel: implement per-model override in the routing config + policy engine. runtime returns `x-rw-precision-applied: model-default|account-override|manual`.
Kaira Nair: experimental thought: allow prompt-level hints inside request body for multi-turn apps to prefer quality for system messages but latency for user prompts. may be complex for cache semantics.
Maggie Chen: note it, but postpone — keep first pass per-request only.
Ben Ops: action items: I'll add runbook steps + toggles. include warmup checklist and rollback play.
Jose9 Alvarez: I'll draft an enforcement spec (who can request what, rate limits, default mapping).
Sam Patel: I'll prototype per-lane queues + merge-on-timeout and push branch for integration tests.
Kaira Nair: I'll assemble A/B prompt lists and the canary eval harness.
quant-bot: flagged: ensure telemetry emits `precision_assigned` with the request_id for offline joins.
Maggie Chen: OK owners noted. keep pricing flat for now; we'll revisit once cost telemetry stabilizes. thanks team :thumbsup:
